id: George Young And Band-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: George Young And Band
long_description:
George has been called “Wellingtons best kept secret”. A soulful songwriter that stretches styles and sonic scenes. A great voice in great musical company. George has been in the mix for a while and he has a raft of new and unheard material. From heart-melters to shoe-movers, you will not be disappointed.

Band:
George Young
Jeremy Desmond
Jason Rapana
Andy Hoy

Music from 9:30pm, FREE ENTRY

id: Boyle Up Brass Band-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Boyle Up Brass Band
long_description:
BoyleUp summer is upon us!!!

The sun is out (hopefully) and the music is blaring. Life is great when you're dancing with friends at a BoyleUp party!!

Come to the Rogue & Vagabond on Saturday 28th November and boogie and be merry with the best drinks in town!! Get your dancing shoes on and come party like you've never partied before.

Tickets are $10 at the door.

Doors open 9pm gig starts 9.30pm
